name: Roake
role: Ranger logistics officer and primary pilot
notes: Established: third member of the 3-person Ranger crew (2-in/1-out doctrine); retained control over timing, routing, and prioritization of field resupply under active threat (homing carrier drone + high-speed porter drones); received Cross's 3D battlefield imagery for analysis. Per Ranger drone doctrine (kit, 2026-07-21 ruling), the logistics officer normally manages the overall drone picture. Gender, full name, and history NOT established.

naming_exemption.authority: Spatha Promotion / Roster Closure / Sentinel Capsule passes — owner-directed 2026-07-21 (recovered-source preservation)

capsule_binding_note: Capsule directory and entity record share one identifier ("char_roake"): this record is in the entity namespace on both sides. Recorded explicitly because the corpus also contains capsules named WITHOUT the kind prefix (e.g. "alric_tann" for char_alric_tann), so "capsule id equals entity id" is a fact about this record, not a rule that holds corpus-wide.

given_name_evidence.source_line: "…with Kellan Roake laying out the trade hub situation…"
given_name_evidence.handling: Recorded as an alias, not written into `name`. The record's name "Roake" is preserved from the sim capture under its existing recovered-source naming exemption; this is the same provenance class, so the fuller form is attested rather than minted.
given_name_evidence.shared_given_name: Canon independently uses "Kellan" for Kellan Durn (Dark Star arc). No full-name collision — different surnames — but noted because this corpus has produced variant forms of one person before (Zylox Verrin / Zylox Rhaegos), and Kellan Durn itself sits beside char_kael_durn.

shipboard_functions.piloting: Primary pilot; threads the Ranger through overlapping fire with no clear origin or priority, drive output fluctuating under the manoeuvre.
shipboard_functions.systems_monitoring: Monitors ship systems aboard the Ranger.
shipboard_functions.signals_and_ew: Reports when all communications directed outside the system are being jammed, and is the crew's referent for locating the interference source.
shipboard_functions.cyber_defence: Detects attempts to hack the Ranger's database.
shipboard_functions.note: Extends the recorded logistics/pilot role: the prose shows him holding the ship's sensor, comms and data surfaces as well as the helm.

operational_authority.extraction_call: Holds the departure decision — "the one who gets them home, or decides they don't leave yet."
operational_authority.relation_to_record: Distinct from the recorded control over timing, routing and prioritisation of field resupply: that governs materiel to the team, this governs the team's own extraction.

intelligence_briefing.content: Briefs the team on the trade hub situation, including which pirate elements are likely already aware of their arrival.

open_referents.claim: "For the last six months, traffic through Kestrel has stayed high" — used as a transit hub or waypoint.

canon_uses_of_the_name.kestrel_detachment: A Sentinel unit — "Four Sentinels from Kestrel Detachment formed a shielded perimeter"; "The Rangers and Kestrel Detachment were still inside".
canon_uses_of_the_name.kestrel_four: An operator callsign within that unit — "Kestrel Four carried most of her weight while Iven maintained a medical line".
canon_uses_of_the_name.kestrels_dime: A vessel — "KESTREL'S DIME crew evacuated; interdiction entered".
canon_uses_of_the_name.all_from: The Dark Star arc narratives, AAR and incident record.

open_referents.why_unresolved: A detachment is not a place traffic routes through. Binding the observation to the Dark Star Kestrel would invent a location; dropping it would lose an attested six-month traffic observation.
open_referents.status: RECORDED — four usages enumerated, referent undetermined.
open_referents.the_fourth_usage: Roake's is a fourth and unlike the others: "for the last six months, traffic through Kestrel has stayed high" — a thing one routes traffic through.
open_referents.connection_not_to_over_read: The Rangers and Kestrel Detachment appear in the same Dark Star scene, and Roake is Ranger crew, so the two contexts do touch. The tempting inference is that Kestrel is a station the detachment is named for. That inference is not made here: units are named for birds, places, founders and battles, and a shared name is not a shared referent.
open_referents.what_would_settle_it: A map-authority row for a Kestrel waypoint, or a source giving the detachment's naming origin. Either closes it; neither exists yet.

prose_ledger_triage.provenance_note: All claims are scene text from the Ranger sim capture. One is metatextual and states the frame directly: the Ranger mission was an L2 discovery space populated only by actors generated inside the sim (Cross, Vorn, Roake, Kade, the antagonists). Recorded because it establishes these as sim-observed facts about an existing crew member, consistent with the record's existing sim_capture_v1 tag, not as world-bible assertions from an external source.
